outcome: adverse events (intraoperative massive haemorrhage or retained products of conception) associated with the termination of Caesarean scar pregnancy (CSP)
cohort: The study cohort consisted of patients diagnosed with Caesarean scar pregnancy (CSP) who underwent Dilation and Curettage (D&C) at two hospitals.
finding: The developed nomogram, incorporating scar thickness, type of CSP, gestational sac diameter, and blood flow, demonstrated excellent discriminative ability and calibration for predicting adverse events during the termination of Caesarean scar pregnancy.
